record.question: Which of the following is the largest linguistic group in India?
record.explanation: Answer D: Indo-Aryan. Indo-Aryan languages make up the largest language family/group in India by speakers. Reference: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/10191. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
